named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findRoot
named-native-query.query: SELECT t.tree_pk ,t.tree_tree_pk_parent ,t.tree_tree_pk_link ,t.tree_name ,t.tree_et_pk ,CASE COALESCE(u.usr_deleted_flg, a.acc_status) WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_code ,t.tree_entity_pk ,et.et_tree_flgs ,t.tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,t.tree_desc ,t.tree_path FROM esq_tree t JOIN esq_entity_type et ON t.tree_et_pk = et.et_pk LEFT JOIN esq_user u ON t.tree_usr_pk = u.usr_pk LEFT JOIN esq_account a ON t.tree_acc_pk = a.acc_pk WHERE t.tree_pk = :rootId AND t.tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findByEntityId
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,CASE COALESCE(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status) WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,et_tree_flgs ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree JOIN esq_entity_type ON tree_et_pk = et_pk LEFT JOIN esq_user ON usr_pk = tree_usr_pk LEFT JOIN esq_account ON acc_pk = tree_acc_pk WHERE tree_entity_pk = CAST(:id as bigint) AND tree_tree_pk_link IS NULL AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findByNameKind
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,CASE COALESCE(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status) WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,et_tree_flgs ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree JOIN esq_entity_type ON tree_et_pk = et_pk LEFT JOIN esq_user ON usr_pk = tree_usr_pk LEFT JOIN esq_account ON acc_pk = tree_acc_pk WHERE tree_name = :name AND tree_et_pk = :kind AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findNodes
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,CASE COALESCE(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status) WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,et_tree_flgs ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree JOIN esq_entity_type ON tree_et_pk = et_pk LEFT JOIN esq_user ON usr_pk = tree_usr_pk LEFT JOIN esq_account ON acc_pk = tree_acc_pk WHERE tree_tree_pk_parent = :id AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findPath
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_path FROM esq_tree WHERE tree_pk = :id AND tree_tree_pk_link IS NULL FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
